eyebrow.en: local · no model download · one command

headline.zh: 下载 1.4TB 之前，先算清你的机器跑不跑得动 Kimi K3
headline.en: Know if your rig can run Kimi K3 — before the 1.4TB download

sub.zh: 输入显存和内存，K3Fit 用 Kimi K3 的 Delta-Attention 记忆模型算出最大上下文、量化档、专家路由和预测 tps。纯算术，不碰模型文件。
sub.en: Enter your VRAM and RAM — K3Fit uses Kimi K3's Delta-Attention memory model to compute max context, quant tier, expert routing, and predicted tps. Pure arithmetic, no model files touched.

body.zh: 1.4TB 的下载要花一整天。一条命令告诉你能开多大上下文、哪档量化放得下、预测 tps 多少——再决定要不要拉。
body.en: A 1.4TB download takes a day. One command tells you the max context, which quant tier fits, and predicted tps — so you decide whether to pull.

title.zh: 为 Kimi K3 的 Delta-Attention 量身计算

body.zh: K3 用 Delta-Attention 替换 69/93 层的 KV cache。标准 KV 计算会算错（1M 上下文 27.2 vs 104.6 GiB）。K3Fit 按真实架构算，不套通用公式。
body.en: K3 replaces KV cache with Delta-Attention in 69 of 93 layers. Standard KV math gets it wrong (1M ctx: 27.2 vs 104.6 GiB). K3Fit computes against the real architecture, not a generic formula.

body.zh: 单 Go 二进制，秒级输出一张表：每档量化能开多大上下文、占多少显存、预测多快。不用装 Python，不用配环境。
body.en: A single Go binary prints a table in under a second: max context per quant, memory used, predicted speed. No Python, no environment setup.

headline.en: Don't pull 1.4TB blind. Run one command first.

sub.en: Local, open-source, answers in a second.
